policy_title: Clean Up Waterways and Support British Farmers
stated: Labour will put failing water companies under special measures, giving regulators new powers to block executive bonuses and bring criminal charges for pollution. They will set a target for half of all public sector food purchases to be locally produced or environmentally certified, introduce a land-use framework, and work with farmers on Bovine TB eradication measures to end the badger cull.

source.quote: Labour will put failing water companies under special measures to clean up our water. We will give regulators new powers to block the payment of bonuses to executives who pollute our waterways and bring criminal charges against persistent law breakers. We will impose automatic and severe fines for wrongdoing and ensure independent monitoring of every outlet. Labour recognises that food security is national security. That is why we will champion British farming whilst protecting the environment. We will set a target for half of all food purchased across the public sector to be locally produced or certified to higher environmental standards. We will introduce a land-use framework and make environment land management schemes work for farmers and nature. And we will work with farmers and scientists on measures to eradicate Bovine TB, protecting livelihoods, so that we can end the ineffective badger cull.

bearing_set.reason: Water company special measures targeting criminal pollution charges directly address water quality; the land-use framework and environmentally certified procurement target also bear on environmental outcomes — all core O6 indicators.

The 50% local/certified public-sector food procurement target creates direct demand for British farm output, affecting farm incomes and employment; the Bovine TB eradication approach shapes farmers' operating costs and herd security, materially affecting agricultural livelihoods.

membership_note: Two clear bearings: O6 (environmental quality, the policy's primary design target) and O4 (farmer income security and livelihoods, a concrete secondary mechanism). Criminal-charge powers for executives are a lever for environmental enforcement (O6), not a material O5 safety or O10 liberty effect at this level of detail. Land-use framework's housing-land implications are too unspecified to reach the non-negligible bar for O1.
